name: advanceduptime
author: Kreusada
kirin
description: Port of Kreusada's advanceduptime, which was removed from Kreusada-Cogs. Replaces the core uptime command with one that shows system uptime, bot, latency and command usage stats. The core command comes back when the cog is unloaded.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall Kreusada's advanceduptime before loading this; its settings carry over.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data.
